joinable_ceiling.note: A UDI bridge can only ever touch rows whose device_identifier is a GTIN-14. That is the hard ceiling, before any matching happens.

confirmed_against_denominators.note: 934 is a confirmed count on a systematic 1200-of-5005 subsample. It is a lower bound on what this method could confirm (3805 GTIN-class values were never queried) and an upper bound on nothing: it is not a population estimate and must not be scaled up.

sampling.subsample_rule: sorted(MDALL GTIN-class raw keys); take index int(i * 5005/1200) for i in range(1200). This is a systematic sample, not a random sample; reproduced exactly in this work.

top_labelers.company: Steris Mexico, S. de R.L. de C.V.

generalisation_statement: At most 5512/1673926 = 0.329% of MDALL active identifier rows, 227/36056 = 0.63% of MDALL licences and 679/146183 = 0.46% of MDALL device lines can ever be joined by an official UDI. ATLAS confirmed 934 of them (0.0558% of all MDALL rows). This is a real but thin official bridge, concentrated in a few manufacturers; it is not a solution to global device identity.

falsifiers.claim: MDALL's device_identifier field contains a GTIN-14 minority as well as model/catalogue tokens.
falsifiers.falsifier: a full scan of the frozen table finds no 14-digit values, or none with valid Mod-10 check digits.
falsifiers.status: survives: 5,512 / 1,673,926 rows are 14-digit; 5,434 rows (4,927 distinct) have valid check digits; 78 distinct invalid-check 14-digit values exist too.

falsifiers.claim: The 934 ATLAS pairs are exact GTIN-14 equalities, not string coincidence.
falsifiers.falsifier: any of the 934 shared identifiers is not 14 digits or fails the Mod-10 check.
falsifiers.status: survives: 934/934 are 14-digit and 934/934 pass the Mod-10 check; 0 blank, 0 duplicate.

falsifiers.claim: The Canada side of each pair is re-derivable from the raw frozen MDALL table.
falsifiers.falsifier: a shared identifier is absent from the raw table, or its licence/device_id does not match.
falsifiers.status: survives: 934/934 present in the raw cache; 934/934 licence match; 934/934 MDALL device_id match.

falsifiers.claim: HORIZON's 0 is a coverage result, not a refutation.
falsifiers.falsifier: HORIZON's Canada slice contains a GTIN-14 identifier, or its US slice shares a DI with ATLAS's 934.
falsifiers.status: survives: 0/49 HORIZON identifier values are 14-digit; 0/934 ATLAS DIs appear in HORIZON's 320 DI slice; 0 shared CA licences.

falsifiers.claim: The two methods are the same rule under different field typing.
falsifiers.falsifier: on the unified 1,660-pair sample, the ATLAS bridge confirms pairs H2's namespace-typing variant does not, or vice versa.
falsifiers.status: survives: namespace-typing confusion is 934/934 both-confirmed and 726/726 neither; native-typing gives 934 ATLAS-only.

falsifiers.claim: The bridge generalises to a cross-border identity solution.
falsifiers.falsifier: the bridge reaches a large share of MDALL rows, or is spread across manufacturers and licences.
falsifiers.status: REFUTED: ceiling 0.33% of rows / 0.63% of licences; 81.4% of confirmations come from one licence and one US labeler; 92.8% from the top four labelers.

falsifiers.claim: The confirmed pairs are corporately coherent on both sides.
falsifiers.falsifier: Canada-side corporate identity cannot be established, or contradicts the US side.
falsifiers.status: not established: 925/934 (99.0%) pairs have no Canada-side company in the frozen data; the 9 that do are GE-only name-alias links.
